audit.why: 49.5% over 202 games against a chart that gives Camille levels 1-3 and the late game and Master Yi levels 6 and first item. An early-dominant lane that concedes the item stages and reclaims late lines up with a near-even headline, so no stage moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is credited to 'Highlander plus true damage' as one lump. The true damage is Wuju Style (E, flat 14s); Highlander (R, flat 85s) gives move and attack speed and, critically, makes him IMMUNE TO SLOWS - which is the actual reason your level-6 disengage fails, and it was never said.
audit.why: Riot, Wuju Style: 'Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.' Highlander: 'temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects.' Cooldowns from champ-data/_kits/masteryi.json.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4] and mid now separate the two and name the slow immunity, which is what makes Tactical Sweep's slow worthless in his ult window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late game rests on 'the true-damage shield', in three places. Adaptive Defenses shields against a damage TYPE - physical or magic - so it cannot absorb true damage at all, and the page's own level-6 line correctly says his true damage 'bites through your shield'. The two claims cannot both stand. Three interactions were also missing: Alpha Strike (Q, 20s) makes him untargetable through your commit; Meditate (W, 10s) is a channel your Hookshot knock-up cancels outright; and Meditate is a heal with no Grievous Wounds call anywhere.
audit.why: Riot, Adaptive Defenses: 'Basic attacks on champions grant a shield equal to a percentage of Camille's maximum health against their damage type (Physical or Magic).' Alpha Strike: 'teleports across the battlefield... while simultaneously becoming untargetable.' Meditate: 'Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage.' _missing-interactions.json flags untargetable-dodges-burst, needs-antiheal and channel-interruptible for this pairing.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text, late and whys[6] drop the impossible true-damage shield and use the real late-game tools instead: the Hookshot cancel on Meditate, waiting out Alpha Strike, and R isolation.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal call against Meditate, his only sustain.
audit.why: Meditate is a flat 10s heal-and-damage-reduction channel, so it comes back inside every skirmish; Grievous Wounds is what stops a lost fight being reset.
audit.corrected: late now pairs the Hookshot cancel with Grievous Wounds.

notes: 'The true-damage shield' appears three times as Camille's late-game answer to Master Yi and is not a thing that exists: Adaptive Defenses shields against physical OR magic, matched to the attacker's damage type, so Wuju Style's true damage passes straight through - which the page's own level-6 line already says. A player reading the late section will hold a shield they think blanks his damage. The replacements are real tools the file never used: Hookshot's knock-up cancels the Meditate channel, Alpha Strike goes untargetable so burst spent into it is wasted, and Highlander's slow immunity is why Tactical Sweep does not buy you the disengage at 6. wants.you and wants.foe here are 13-30 character labels, so the +/-10% band leaves no room to add anything.
